ui-logic-fix-orchestrate.title: Orchestrate UI logic fixes from parallel reviews
ui-logic-fix-orchestrate.description: Drive the fix track for findings from logic_review_claude.md + logic_review_codex.md. May spawn sub-workers (this is an orchestration task — sub-worker dispatch is in scope here, unlike the review/capture tasks). Stops after all critical/important findings landed and verified.
acceptCriteria: All 3 high-confidence findings (RowState.Error persistence, userPrompt persistence, headline text fallback) fixed
I7 dropped or refactored after C3
Either all instrumented tests pass OR new ones added covering the round-trip behaviors fixed
